text.title: Pike
text.nearby: A pike lurks nearby, still as a log.
text.chasing: A pike is after you! Hide under the old boat or in the pondweed!
text.bite: A pike bit you! Swim for cover!
text.about_looks: Long and green with pale spots, a flat snout like a duck's bill and lots of sharp teeth.
text.about_food: Other fish, and sometimes frogs or even ducklings.
text.about_home: Hides among reeds and water plants close to the shore.
text.about_winter: Stays active under the ice and keeps hunting fish.
text.about_young: Lays its eggs in flooded shallows right after the ice melts in spring.
text.about_fact: A pike waits without moving, then strikes in a flash. Its green spots hide it among the plants.

year.shelter: Waits in ambush among reeds and water plants; stays active under the ice.
year.young: Spawns right after the ice melts, in April–May, in flooded shallows.
